_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Score sits in a coil on the Complacency band with two-sided tension (crowded longs, dead ETF flows, flat funding); no named breaker, so HOLD is the graded base-rate call.
next_move.brains_agree: Partial — Analyst explicitly HOLD/Complacency next; Narrative silent on forward phase but outflow slowdown does not contradict the coil/HOLD case
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC remains range-bound, F&G pinned ~47-54, funding near flat, no ETF-flow or vol impulse breaks the score band
next_move.invalidated_if: Score >55 on renewed ETF flows/CVD (up into Disbelief) or long-unwind with skew/VIX spike drives score <47 (back into Anxiety)
